title: Contents Packout & Storage Site Wait Charge on Return Loads
content:
Delivering Contents Packout & Storage contents to a property whose rebuild the company has not yet closed out costs crew waiting time, and the wait charge is keyed on the contract's status alone. On the move-back truck line of a return: **when the company rebuild contract read at the job's loss address is in substantially complete status, each return load carries the open-site wait charge; when it is in final invoiced status, each return load carries the invoiced-site wait charge; in any other status, or with no company rebuild contract read at that address, no wait charge applies.**

The company rebuild contract read at the job's loss address is the one at that address on the job's own claim file, or with no claim file when the job has none, and among those the one furthest along, taking a closed contract first, then a final invoiced, substantially complete, in construction, permitted, signed and proposed one in that order; a cancelled contract is never read; the company keeps one rebuild contract per claim file and address, added scope for the same claim and address being written as a change order on it, so no two contracts share that place in the order.

| Status of the Reconstruction contract read | Wait charge per return load |
|---|---|
| substantially complete | 35.00 (open-site) |
| final invoiced | 15.00 (invoiced-site) |
| any other status, including closed | none |
| no company rebuild contract read at the address | none |

**Hypothetical illustration.** 3 return loads to an address whose contract read is final invoiced carry 3 times 15.00, or 45.00, in waiting time.
